tasks.title: Laravel dependency + build hygiene fix in this repo (project root): the installed symfony/yaml is v7.4.1, which IS affected by CVE-2026-45133 (YAML parser stack exhaustion via unbounded recursion; fixed in >=7.4.12 / >=8.0.12). Run `composer update symfony/yaml` (v7.4.15 is available and within constraints), then confirm `composer show symfony/yaml` reports a patched version (>=7.4.12). Re-run `composer audit` and report whether the advisory is gone (0 advisories expected). Then run `npm audit` and report the summary (counts by severity) — do NOT run `npm audit fix`, just report. Finally run `npx mix --production` and confirm the production JS/CSS build compiles cleanly (exit 0). Do NOT modify composer.json or package.json, do NOT run `composer update` for any other package, do NOT commit. Report the exact symfony/yaml version before/after, the composer audit result, the npm audit summary, and the npx mix result.

Laravel migration hygiene fix in this repo (project root), file database/migrations/2026_08_08_100825_create_quot_quotation_tables.php: the Schema::create('quot_quotation_exclusions', ...) block (~lines 153-161) declares only id/quot_id/exclusion_id/remarks/created_at/updated_at + primary key, with NO foreign keys — while every sibling pivot table in the same migration declares them (see the quot_quotation_remarks block ~lines 163-175 for the exact convention: $table->index(['quot_id'], 'quot_id'); $table->index(['exclusion_id'], 'exclusion_id'); then $table->foreign('quot_id', 'quot_quotation_exclusions_ibfk_1')->references('id')->on('quot_quotations')->restrictOnDelete()->restrictOnUpdate(); and $table->foreign('exclusion_id', 'quot_quotation_exclusions_ibfk_2')->references('id')->on('quot_exclusions')->restrictOnDelete()->restrictOnUpdate();). Add the two index() + two foreign() declarations inside the existing exclusions block, matching the sibling block's order and style. Do NOT modify any other table or block, do NOT change the down() drop order, do NOT create a new migration file, do NOT touch anything else. Then run `php -l database/migrations/2026_08_08_100825_create_quot_quotation_tables.php` and confirm it parses cleanly. (MariaDB is NOT running on this machine, so do NOT attempt php artisan migrate.)

Write and run a unit test for the new quot_quotation_exclusions foreign keys in this repo (project root). Create tests/Unit/QuotationExclusionsForeignKeyTest.php: a plain PHPUnit test with NO database connection (MariaDB is not running on this machine), following the EXACT conventions of the existing tests/Unit/MassAssignmentGuardTest.php and tests/Unit/UploadValidationTest.php — use dirname(__DIR__, 2) for the project root path (NOT base_path(), which throws under `php artisan test --filter` on this setup) and comment-aware asserts. Read database/migrations/2026_08_08_100825_create_quot_quotation_tables.php as a string and assert: (1) the quot_quotation_exclusions block declares $table->foreign('quot_id', 'quot_quotation_exclusions_ibfk_1') referencing ->on('quot_quotations') with restrictOnDelete; (2) the block declares $table->foreign('exclusion_id', 'quot_quotation_exclusions_ibfk_2') referencing ->on('quot_exclusions') with restrictOnDelete; (3) the exclusions block (not the remarks block) contains both foreign declarations. Then run `php artisan test` and report the result with the test report contract. IMPORTANT context for the report: the full suite has 2 KNOWN environmental failures (tests/Feature/OutstationEditTest.php — PDO connection refused because MariaDB is not running); those are expected and unrelated — the Unit suite including the new test must pass (currently 39 unit tests / 123 assertions before this change). Do NOT try to fix the OutstationEditTest failures.
